design.purpose: A compact connected stand for holding a pen, stylus, or charging cable across two brick towers on a desk.

steps.c: Place the brown 2×8 plate flat as the base.
Press the dark red brick onto the left end.
Press the red brick onto the right end.
Press the green brick squarely onto the dark red brick.
Press the orange brick squarely onto the red brick.
Check both towers are fully pressed down and level.
